'''Scabby''' was a pet [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rat]] owned by the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Dakk'ik]]. After Dakk'ik joined the salvaging crew of [[Blizz]], he went with them to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and took Scabby with him. Unfortunately, Scabby could not survive the cold temperature of Hoth and perished.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Scabby appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during the Blizz Alliance alert mission.<ref name="SWTOR" />
